description: This source file implements fallback mechanisms for MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) backend in PyTorch, handling unsupported operators by either falling back to CPU implementation or raising not implemented errors. It also includes profiling hooks for CPU fallback operations and registration of fallback functions for specific operators.

methods.name: mps_fallback
methods.description: Handles unsupported MPS operators by profiling (if enabled) and falling back to CPU implementation.

methods.name: mps_error_fallback
methods.description: Raises a not implemented error for unsupported MPS operators with instructions for fallback setup.

methods.name: slow_conv2d_forward_mps
methods.description: A placeholder function asserting that slow convolution should not be called on MPS device with mismatched tensors.
